sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday, looking to bounce back after their most recent loss. Sandbach remain firmly at the top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and despite the recent setback they have a strong underlying record with seven wins from their last six matches before that loss. Alsager Town are struggling near the bottom with just one win all season, making this a golden opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face Dawley Town away; Stafford are just two points behind Sandbach and will be keen to capitalise if the leaders slip up. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what looks like a mid-table tussle between two sides separated by just one point—Eccleshall are in fifth with recent form showing a win, while Bridgnorth have recovered from two successive losses. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) travel to face Wednesfield Community in a fixture between mid-table sides. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir; Bilston are sixth with solid recent form while Foley Meir sit lower in the standings. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a battle between inconsistent sides, while Shawbury United face Barnton—Shawbury are in alarming form with six consecutive losses. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-battle fixture, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's bottom side with just two points from seven games. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a clash between struggling lower-table teams.
